## Weight loss FAQs

### What is included in the Ro Body membership?

The Ro Body membership includes access to GLP-1 medication, a personalized treatment plan, dedicated insurance concierge, ongoing provider support with 1:1 messaging, regular check-ins, coaching, and lab testing, if necessary. The cost of medication is not included in the Ro Body membership fee.

### How much does the Ro Body membership cost?

The Ro Body membership costs $39 for the first month and as low as $74/month when you prepay for an annual plan. If you stay on a monthly plan, the ongoing cost is $149/month.

Please note that the cost of GLP-1 medication is not included in the membership cost. Medication cost will depend on your treatment and insurance coverage.

### How much do GLP-1s cost?

Costs vary based on medication and dose, whether you use insurance or pay cash, and if you choose Prepay & Save.

**Using insurance?** Our insurance concierge fights for coverage—which means your medication cost might just be your copay.

**Paying cash?** You have access to the lowest-price GLP-1s—at the same prices as LillyDirect®, NovoCare®, and TrumpRx. New patients can start on the first dose of Wegovy pill or Foundayo pill for $149/mo.

On Ro, Prepay & Save can unlock even more savings.

**Additional Ro Body membership fee required**. The Ro Body membership fee is as low as $74/month when you prepay for an annual plan.

### When do I get charged for the membership and medication?

You will only be charged the Ro Body membership fee if you are eligible for treatment.
Once approved for treatment, you’ll be charged for the medication based on your insurance coverage, or if you're paying cash.

### Are the medication prices the same as NovoCare®, LillyDirect®, and TrumpRx?

Yes! Ro offers FDA-approved GLP-1s at the lowest cash pay prices available—the same pricing as NovoCare®, LillyDirect®, and TrumpRx. On Ro, Prepay & Save can unlock even more savings.
